titleAr: فتح مساحة عمل Chat من غير متجر
titleEn: Create an Ebda Chat workspace without a Store

ar: ازاي افتح Ebda Chat من غير متجر؟
ازاي اعمل مساحة عمل Chat بحسابي؟
en: How do I start Ebda Chat without a store?
Can I create a workspace with my own account?

steps: Sign in with an Ebda AI Studio account (verified email), choose Create a workspace, give it a name, then open the inbox
edgeCases: Creation is open to any verified account (STANDALONE_WORKSPACES=open); one owned workspace per person; at most 3 attempts per person and 10 per network address a day; the other methods on /workspaces are refused (person-level wildcard mount)
Standalone workspaces have no orders, catalogue, COD or recommendations
gaps: No self-service account deletion in Chat
assistantNote: a workspace is created from the sign-in flow; the assistant only exists inside a workspace
